outfits.name: Base (swimwear)
outfits.prompt: A twenty-year-old woman of fair, lightly freckled skin and a slender, athletic build, standing at an average height. Her hair is a short, choppy, deliberately messy bob of deep inky black with faint indigo highlights, framing her face in a just-rolled-out-of-bed style. Her eyes are a vivid ocean-blue, almond-shaped, resting in a half-lidded, sleepy gaze. A faint dusting of sun-kissed freckles traces across the bridge of her nose and upper cheeks. She wears a simple black bikini top with thin straps and matching black bikini bottoms, a loose white linen button-up shirt left unbuttoned and pushed back past her elbows, and a thin braided leather bracelet on her left wrist. She stands with one hand hooking the hem of her open shirt at her hip, the other hand raised to push messy bangs off her forehead, weight shifted onto one leg, head tilted slightly back with an air of effortless cool.

outfits.name: Beach Meet-Cute
outfits.prompt: A twenty-year-old woman of fair, lightly freckled skin and a slender, athletic build, standing at an average height. Her hair is a short, choppy, deliberately messy bob of deep inky black that catches faint indigo highlights in the sun, framing her face in a just-rolled-out-of-bed style. Her eyes are a vivid ocean-blue, wide and almond-shaped, resting in a half-lidded, sleepy gaze that reads as both unbothered and sharply observant. A faint dusting of sun-kissed freckles traces across the bridge of her nose and upper cheeks. She wears a faded oversized vintage band tee — washed-out grey cotton with a cracked print — knotted at the waist, revealing a cropped black bikini top underneath. Below, frayed-hem denim cutoff shorts sit low on her hips. She is barefoot, sand dusting her ankles. A pair of cheap black sunglasses is pushed up into her messy hair, and a thin silver chain necklace rests against her collarbone. She stands with her weight shifted onto one hip, one hand loosely hooking a thumb through a belt loop while the other dangles a plastic iced coffee cup at her side, her head tilted slightly back, chin lifted with a faint smirk tugging at the corner of her lips.

outfits.name: Art-School Casual
outfits.prompt: A twenty-year-old woman with a slender, athletic build and fair, lightly freckled skin. Her hair is a short, choppy, deliberately messy bob of deep inky black with faint indigo highlights, framing her face in a just-rolled-out-of-bed style. Her vivid ocean-blue eyes are almond-shaped and rest in a half-lidded, sleepy gaze. A faint dusting of sun-kissed freckles traces across the bridge of her nose and upper cheeks. She wears a fitted white ribbed cotton crop tank beneath an oversized washed-out grey graphic tee with the sleeves rolled once at the cuffs, the hem falling to her midriff. Baggy low-rise carpenter jeans in faded blue denim are cuffed at the ankle, paired with scuffed white canvas high-top sneakers. A faded blue denim jacket is slouched loosely over her shoulders rather than worn properly, the collar upturned at the back. Small silver hoop earrings sit in her earlobes. She stands with her weight shifted onto one hip, one hand hooking the front pocket of her jeans, the other hand loosely gripping the collar of the denim jacket draped behind her, her head tilted slightly to one side.

outfits.name: House Party Host
outfits.prompt: A twenty-year-old woman of fair, lightly freckled skin and a slender, athletic build, standing at an average height. A thin black cord necklace with a small silver pendant rests against her collarbone. outfits.name: Reluctant Date Night
outfits.prompt: A twenty-year-old woman with fair, lightly freckled skin and a slender, athletic build. Her hair is a short, choppy, deliberately messy bob of deep inky black with faint indigo highlights, framing her face in a just-rolled-out-of-bed style. Her vivid ocean-blue eyes are almond-shaped and half-lidded. Faint sun-kissed freckles trace across the bridge of her nose and upper cheeks. She wears a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sleeveless bodysuit tucked into high-waisted olive-green wide-leg trousers, paired with black leather ankle boots featuring a low block heel. A delicate silver pendant hangs at her collarbone. A structured dark denim jacket sits over her shoulders. Her left hand grips the hem of the denim jacket, tugging it downward at her side, while her right hand rests deep in her trouser pocket. Her weight shifts onto one hip, her chin tilted slightly down with her shoulders drawn inward, the posture of someone unused to looking this put-together and quietly resenting the effort.
